entry.title: Updated: dsh-web-preview
entry.summary: Side web-preview panel: local static hosting, Markdown/code/image preview, one-click run of non-static projects (Cargo/npm/Go/Python) with live logs, drag files into the chat (saved to the workspace), element mark & annotate, workspace file search on 404, and link-click takeover into the side panel. Exact install spec: github:zoumutou/dsh-web-preview. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: description, description_i18n.
